title: Abeon Event Envelope
description: Generic envelope wrapping every event on RabbitMQ exchange `abeon.events`. Per-event payload schemas (the contents of `data`) live in each service's own repo and are discovered via composer extra.abeon.event-schemas.

org_id.description: Organisation this event belongs to (ADR-0016). Top-level rather than inside `actor`, because a system-generated event has no actor but still belongs to a tenant. `null` = platform-level event with no organisation — never 'all organisations'; a consumer that requires a tenant must refuse a null (ADR-0018).

data.description: Event-specific payload. v1: loose. v0.2+: strict against per-service schema.
